MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 8

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 28

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 14

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 25

10. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 16

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

14. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

15. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 8

16. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

17. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 13

18. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

20. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

22. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

23. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 5

24. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
